title: Can I SURVIVE Setup Chess?
summary: The creator plays chess.com Setup Chess against higher-rated humans, aiming for three wins. Before play, each side alternately places pieces worth up to 39 points of material anywhere in its own first three ranks (king placed last/committed), then a normal game is played. He favours many bishops on long diagonals plus rooks behind 'huts' of pawns, puts his king on h8, and wins games 1-3 (one by the opponent flagging, one by resignation).
rules: Placement phase: players alternate placing one piece at a time onto their own first three ranks (White ranks 1-3, Black ranks 6-8).
Each side has a 39-point budget (P=1, N=3, B=3, R=5, Q=9); any combination, e.g. many bishops, is allowed. The king must be placed (free) and can be committed at any time.
After both sides finish placing, a normal game of chess is played from that position.
Inactivity during placement can time you out; clock with increment in play.
win_condition: Checkmate (or opponent resigns/flags). Goal: win 3 games vs higher-rated opponents.

board.shape_notes: standard; placement zone = own first three ranks
